title: Counting Day of the Extension Maximum — Homesite Reservation
content:
The extension maximum for a Homesite Reservation hold extension is counted from one of three days, and the extension maximum offset is the calendar days from the reservation date to that day.

## Rule

1. Where a payment received with the component reinstatement fee stands on the reservation, the extension maximum is counted from the latest posting date of such a payment, and the offset is the calendar days from the reservation date to that date.
2. Where no such payment stands and the required funds became complete on a day after the reservation date, the extension maximum is counted from that completion day, and the offset is the calendar days from the reservation date to it.
3. Otherwise the extension maximum is counted from the reservation date, and the offset is zero.

The day the required funds became complete is the latest posting date of a payment received with the component reservation deposit, or, where the class carries a premium holding fee above zero, the later of that date and the latest posting date of a payment received with the component premium holding fee.

## Date illustrations (hypothetical reservation dated 1 August)

| Ledger shows | Counting day | Offset |
|---|---|---|
| reinstatement fee payments posted 20 August and 22 August | 22 August | 21 |
| no reinstatement fee payment; reservation deposit completed 3 August; class without a premium holding fee | 3 August | 2 |
| no reinstatement fee payment; reservation deposit completed 1 August, premium holding fee completed 4 August | 4 August | 3 |
| no reinstatement fee payment; all required funds posted 1 August | 1 August | 0 |
